Accepted full affirmative solution of the discrete initial additive-group question posed by Kaplan and Ehrlich: OWR60/2016 suppliedprinted3356 Question1 (problem30003321), earlier Kaplan2015honorsthesisQ1p47 and sequel authorQ9.1p15; arXivv1Q2p18.

Published preprint: **[10.5281/zenodo.23444606](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23444606)**. [Zenodo record/downloads](https://zenodo.org/records/23444606) contain the seven-page research note and source/verification archive. Alec Kriebel, ORCID0009-0001-9320-500X, v1.0.0,17October2026, CC BY4.0.

Every discrete initial ordered ADDITIVE subgroup G of No has an order-group isomorphism ONTO H contained in Oz that is initial in No. Sets and proper classes are included in NBG with global choice, and the zero group is handled separately. No multiplicative closure or preservation of original simplicity is assumed. An explicit ordinal-length sign operation moves the least exponent to zero, preserves initial image and reflects the target right-predecessor obligations. Actual source series are relabeled, with only the bottom coefficient group normalized; no full Hahn completion is silently added.

The main construction is unchanged. The operative13-file PR edition and paper supply a detailed dependency proof repairing two literal details in the imported characterization proof: bounded exponent stages need not exhaust cofinal supports, and dyadic limit perturbations may be absent from the coefficient groups. Actual support-length generators, legal unit-cut options, direct additive cut adjunction and actual set restrictions for classes close those gaps. The established characterization statement is credited and retained, not refuted or claimed new. The exact inverse and actual coefficient membership are explicit. Earlier original inputs and no-correction reports remain clearly historical.

Root plus three fresh full mathematical approaches checked the entire target; a fourth focused dependency reviewer reconstructed sufficiency and direct adjunction. Its limited mechanism exposure before full writeup is disclosed. Three fresh priority approaches and root made extensive bounded primary-source checks. Earlier EK characterization/least-positive form, ADH negative-ordinal minimum, canonical initial integer parts and generic exponent/coefficient transport (e.g.Kaplan–Krapp–Serra2025/2026) receive explicit credit. No earlier recorded full target was verified in accessible inspected material. This is not a novelty, firstness, causal-independence or continued-global-openness certificate. The2024 Ehrlich chapter, full2001 predecessor, Lurie1998 and other access-limited fulltexts remain unread leads; author/arXiv versions are not universally authenticated publisher bodies. Only the2024chapter abstract/references were read. [Priority decision](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/9eb027dcf3b7c7a9eba3a31adf754962402a1123/draft_pr_actual_claims_1100_1200_20261017/audits/pr1151_30003321/ROOT_PRIORITY_DECISION.md).

Two successive NEW no-parent-history whole-package adversarial reviews passed the IDENTICAL six-file release without unresolved issues: [package_02](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/9eb027dcf3b7c7a9eba3a31adf754962402a1123/draft_pr_actual_claims_1100_1200_20261017/audits/pr1151_30003321/reviews/package_02/REPORT.md), [package_03](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/9eb027dcf3b7c7a9eba3a31adf754962402a1123/draft_pr_actual_claims_1100_1200_20261017/audits/pr1151_30003321/reviews/package_03/REPORT.md). Each reviewer sealed target/own mathematical analysis before reading prior verdict bodies; these are supplied-candidate reviews, not blind independent discovery. Exact exposures and selective source reads are documented. [Independence disclosure](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/9eb027dcf3b7c7a9eba3a31adf754962402a1123/draft_pr_actual_claims_1100_1200_20261017/audits/pr1151_30003321/REVIEW_INDEPENDENCE.md).

The offline runner authenticates all128 frozen authored audit members and final PDF/source identities. The exact finite-sign program gives two byte-exact complete positive outputs, normal and optimized Python, plus8actual computed-property wrong-construction failures. The current13-file edition verifier also passes. All145source members are authenticated; extracted-source normal/optimized rebuilds reproduce allsix release files with the same runtime. Small tamper/path/type controls pass. These diagnostics support the universal written proof and do not prove arbitrary ordinals/classes or supply a formal proof certificate. Unavailable historical programs are not represented as rerun. Third-party source bodies/extracts/renders/rawreturns are excluded, and optional full custody checks require independently obtaining private sources.

AI tools were used extensively in solving, writing, researching, reproducing and adversarial verification. This preprint is **unrefereed**. Internal AI reviews are not external human peer review, journal acceptance or proof-assistant certification. No human outreach was prepared or initiated.
